def full_years_remaining_until(birth, target_age, today):
    by, bm, bd = birth
    ty, tm, td = today
    had_birthday_this_year = (tm > bm) or (tm == bm and td >= bd)
    age = (ty - by) if had_birthday_this_year else (ty - by - 1)
    return target_age - age

    parts = date_str.split('-')
    year = parts[0]
    month = parts[1]
    day = parts[2]
    return month + '/' + day + '/' + year
